title: T2 is rejected by its supervisor, reworked, then approved; all three tasks verified and merged
plan:
# Wave 3 — ledger-api: invoice pagination, money rounding, docs

Rules
- Each task runs in its own worktree under .worktrees/.
- An independent supervisor re-runs the task's must_run commands and returns a verdict.
- Merge a task into main only after its supervisor verdict is ok=true.
- A rejected task goes back to the same agent for rework. No scope cuts without user approval.

## T1 — Cursor pagination for GET /invoices
Add `cursor` and `limit` query params to the invoices list endpoint.
must_run:
- `pytest tests/api/test_invoices.py -q`

## T2 — Banker's rounding in Money.round()
Switch `ledger/money.py` to ROUND_HALF_EVEN and cover the .5 edge cases, including negatives.
must_run:
- `pytest tests/ledger/test_money.py -q`
- `ruff check ledger`

## T3 — API docs for pagination
Document the new params in docs/api/invoices.md.
must_run:
- `python scripts/check_docs_links.py docs/api`

## Done when
Every task has an ok=true supervisor verdict and is merged into main; `pytest -q` is green on main.
